name: Spicy African Tofu-Peanut Stew with Sweet Potato, Kale, Cilantro & Rice (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g sweet potato
1 red bell pepper
1 mango
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, medium dice tofu and place in a medium bowl. Add cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp cornstarch
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crispy, 7-8 minutes. Transfer 1 cup to a plate, then return remaining tofu to the bowl. Set both aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice sweet potato. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.

When the tofu is done, return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, ginger, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp minced ginger
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and tomatoes to the pot. Stir to combine the stew, then bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until sweet potatoes are tender and stew has thickened, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; cut into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate with the tofu and set aside.
When the stew has thickened, add peanut butter to the pot, and stir to combine. Transfer 1 ½ cups of mild stew to a small bowl and set aside.

Add kale to the pot with the remaining stew in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add reserved tofu in the bowl, cumin, and cayenne pepper to the pot, then stir to combine the spicy stew. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ (283 g) bag kale, cut and ready to use
½ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Roughly chop peanuts.

FOR THE KIDS PLATES: Divide 1 cup of rice between plates, along with reserved mild stew, tofu, and mango. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice between bowls. Top with spicy stew, cilantro, and peanuts. Enjoy!
